about_the_game:
《Fluffy Kitchen Saga》 is a restaurant simulation game at the bottom of your screen. Manage your diner while working/studying/handling tasks. Serve fluffy customers dishes to earn coins, upgrade recipes, and unlock new fluffy patrons. Relaxing gameplay where fluffies accompany you daily~

Includes: 20+ furniture sets (tables, chairs, counters, decor, carpets), 50+ cookable dishes, N super-experienced staff, 4 mysterious customer groups (100+ total!), and multiple interactive minigames.

♥Gameplay♥

  • Welcome Customers: Greet adorable fluffy customers of various species—kittens, puppies, bunnies, and more! These super-cute furballs are guaranteed to melt your heart. Feel free to give them a gentle poke if you're curious...

  • Unlock Dishes: Unlock over 50 delicious dishes (global cuisines, desserts, bubble tea)! Welcome customers, serve them tasty meals, earn coins to upgrade your dishes, and unlock more fluffy new customers!

  • Diner Staff: Meet your ultra-professional team: Bao Bao the leopard host, receptionists, cleaners, chefs, and promoters. With their help, your diner will thrive—spotless floors, mouthwatering food, and happy customers!

  • Fortune-Telling: Draw a daily luck slip! Will it be "Minor Blessing: Emoji Shield" or "Today’s a Lucky Day! Reverse Bad Luck"?

  • Music Time: The jukebox in the diner plays tunes! Discover what kind of music these fluffy critters groove to daily.

  • Mini-Games: Take a break from diner management and enjoy games like Blackjack and Food Fusion!

P.S. If you enjoy casual & management sims, this game is for you (the world needs adorable fluffies~).

Languages: Simplified&Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese.
